title: GHOST corpus manifest
description: Draft schema interpreting GHOST v1.0 section 4.1.1 and section 2 (corpus manifest): the signed declaration of the corpus, each source's identity, provenance, license basis, and content hash where the material is held locally. The corpus is enumerated, not implied.

closingDate.description: For a projection's corpus: the date after which the subject will say nothing further (9.2).

licenseBasis.description: The declared basis: purchased copy, public captions, public domain, licensed private material, study copy with no basis of its own. Honesty over neatness.

held.description: Whether the material is held locally. If true, hash is required.

exclusions.description: What is deliberately out of corpus, recorded so the exclusion cannot be silent.

signature.description: Signing is the operator's act; for official class the profile is signed by the subject's own key (8.1). Shape deferred to the SAGA signature format.
